source_text: Et adhuc eo loquente, ecce Judas unus ex duodecim venit, et cum eo turba multa cum gladiis et fustibus missi a principibus sacerdotum. Propter multitudinem credentium timuerunt ne raperetur; ego autem existimo eos putasse eum magicis disciplinis posse effugere. Gloria Christo. Amen.
pass_a_gloss: And still him speaking, behold Judas one out-of twelve came, and with him crowd great with swords and clubs sent from chiefs of-priests. Because-of multitude of-believers they-feared lest he-be-snatched; I however suppose them to-have-thought him by magical disciplines to-be-able to-flee. Glory to Christ. Amen.
pass_b_english: While he was still speaking, [[Judas, one of the twelve, came, and with him a great crowd with swords and clubs >> Bible:Matthew 26:47]], sent from the chief priests. Some say they feared the multitude of believers would snatch him away; I think they supposed he could escape by magical arts — having heard how he had once slipped those who would throw him down. Glory to Christ. Amen.
notes: Melito skipped; never Cyril Matthew densify.
